what_it_is: No cheats. 90 hours. All characters level 99. All three master materias for each fighter. Ready to fight either Emerald or Ruby weapon.

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: zip of 1 PS3 export(s) (.PSV): '\0VSP' header (signature, save name at 0x64), the save's blocks from 0x84 (8324 bytes); it holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASCUS-94163FF7-S15)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr BASCUS-941634646372D533135.PSV: puts the save(s) on a freshly formatted card, as MemcardRex imports a single save
